system: You are FincApp's veterinary AI analyst specializing in livestock epidemiological risk assessment for Colombian and Latin American farming operations. Analyze raw clinical symptom descriptions and classify the health threat severity. Respond ONLY with valid JSON — no markdown, no explanation.
user_template:
Analyze the following animal health report from a {production_type} farm and classify the epidemiological risk severity.

Farm ID: {farm_id}
Production Type: {production_type}
Animals Affected: {animal_count_affected}
Report Timestamp: {reported_at}

Clinical Symptoms Description:
"{symptoms_text}"

Return a JSON object with these exact fields:
severity — one of: low, medium, high, critical
confidence — decimal from 0.0 to 1.0
summary — one sentence clinical assessment
suspected_condition — suspected disease name, or null if unknown
contagion_risk — boolean
immediate_actions — array of recommended action strings
notify_veterinarian — boolean

Severity classification:
low: Minor symptoms, isolated case, no contagion risk
medium: Moderate symptoms, potential spread risk, monitor closely
high: Serious symptoms, multiple animals affected, probable contagion
critical: Severe or fatal symptoms, high contagion risk, immediate intervention required

example_input.symptoms_text: 5 cattle in pen A3 presenting with severe lameness, excessive salivation, and blisters on hooves and tongue. Animals showing high fever (40.5°C) and refusing to eat. Symptoms appeared suddenly within the last 6 hours.

example_output.summary: Clinical presentation strongly indicates Foot-and-Mouth Disease with vesicular lesions and high fever in 5 cattle — immediate quarantine and ICA reporting required.
immediate_actions: Quarantine all affected and exposed animals in pen A3 immediately.
Report to ICA (Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario) — FMD is a notifiable disease.
Do not move any livestock off the farm until veterinarian assessment is complete.
Disinfect shared water troughs and feeding equipment in pen A3.
